description: Verify Wave2 produced the three-artifact group: synthesis.md (narrative projection with W2F-xxx references), cross-topic-ledger.md (6 fixed sections), finding-index.yaml (parseable YAML with required fields). Also verify Markdown link cross-references exist and resolve, backfill tokens are replaced, and trace evidence is present. Source-gate status-window and handoff witness are enforced by shared gate preflight.

rules.failure_message: Missing file: artifacts/wave2/synthesis.md. Write a cross-topic narrative projection referencing Wave0/Wave1 artifacts and W2F-xxx finding ids.
artifacts/wave2/synthesis.md is empty. Write a cross-topic synthesis that references Wave0 and Wave1 artifacts.
Missing file: artifacts/wave2/cross-topic-ledger.md. Build the cross-topic ledger with scan matrix, legacy questions, resolutions, emergent questions, exploration decisions, and HITL2 handoff.
artifacts/wave2/cross-topic-ledger.md is empty. Populate all 6 fixed sections with finding data.

rules.pattern: ## Cross-Topic Scan Matrix[\s\S]*## Wave1 Legacy Questions[\s\S]*## Cross-Topic Resolutions[\s\S]*## Emergent Cross-Topic Questions[\s\S]*## Exploration Decisions[\s\S]*## HITL2 Handoff
rules.failure_message: cross-topic-ledger.md is missing one or more required section headings. Ensure all 6 sections (Cross-Topic Scan Matrix, Wave1 Legacy Questions, Cross-Topic Resolutions, Emergent Cross-Topic Questions, Exploration Decisions, HITL2 Handoff) are present.
Missing file: artifacts/wave2/finding-index.yaml. Write the JS-readable shadow index with 11 required fields per finding.
finding-index.yaml is not valid YAML. Fix syntax errors.
synthesis.md contains no W2F-xxx finding id reference. Add finding id references to link narrative claims back to the ledger/index.

No valid artifact references found in synthesis. Add at least one Markdown link (e.g. [label](../wave1/topic-a/evidence-summary.md)) that points to an existing Wave0 or Wave1 artifact file in the bundle.
synthesis.md contains no reference to wave1 evidence-summary.md or question-list.md. Add at least one Markdown link to a wave1 deepening artifact.
Rerun action:add requires full Wave2 re-synthesis: no Delta Synthesis as the main path, and ledger/index coverage must include every topic slug.
Unreplaced __BACKFILL_WAVE2_JUDGMENT__ token found in seed topic file. Execute backfill task: project cross-topic judgments from ledger/index.
Unreplaced __BACKFILL_PENDING_QUESTIONS__ token found in seed topic file. Execute backfill task: update question status labels from ledger/index.
No wave2_completion trace event found in rb_trace.jsonl. The phase must write a completion trace event per the shared-subagent-protocol.

rules._comment: Wave2 conditional provenance: only triggered when search/evidence/reference outputs exist (reference/00-cross-*.md). Pure synthesis/backfill artifacts (synthesis.md, cross-topic-ledger.md, finding-index.yaml) do NOT require relay provenance.
rules.failure_message: Wave2 promoted cross references (reference/00-cross-*.md) exist without relay provenance. These must be produced through delegated relay tasks (dpt-topic-scout or dpt-evidence-extractor). Direct-written cross references are not valid.
